office_explainer: The governor runs the state's executive branch: proposes the state budget, signs or vetoes bills the legislature passes, and appoints the people who run state departments. A term is four years.
why_it_matters: Gov. Bill Lee has served two terms and can't run again, so Tennessee will have a new governor. Two party nominees and 13 independents are on the ballot.

candidates.name: Marsha Blackburn
candidates.background: U.S. senator since 2019. Before that, U.S. House member for Tennessee's 7th District (2003 to 2019) and state senator (1998 to 2002). Born in Laurel, Mississippi; degree from Mississippi State University (WSMV).

candidates.name: Jerri Green
candidates.background: Attorney and Memphis City Council member since 2023. Born in Memphis; degrees from the University of Tennessee, Knoxville and Georgetown University's law school (WSMV).

candidates.name: Misam Abidi
candidates.background: Founded a credit consulting company that later moved into cryptocurrency; also drives for Uber and sells renewable energy. Born in Lahore, Pakistan; came to the U.S. in 1997. WSMV reports a grand jury indicted him in June on 11 counts tied to an alleged "crypto Ponzi scheme."

candidates.name: Dean Brewer
candidates.background: From Lenoir City; lives in Knoxville. Running for his first public office (WSMV).

candidates.name: Ray Brown
candidates.background: Electrician from Oliver Springs (WSMV).

candidates.name: David Hatley
candidates.background: Owns a hot tub manufacturing business. From Elizabethtown; no past political office (WSMV).

candidates.name: Wendell Jackson
candidates.background: Performer and comedian from Clarksville (WSMV).

candidates.name: Charles Van Morgan
candidates.background: Business owner, former police officer and Tennessee Highway Patrol deputy; ran for governor in 2022. Law degree from Nashville School of Law; lives in Knoxville (WSMV).

candidates.name: Eddie Lee Murphy
candidates.background: From Spring Hill. Ran in the October 2025 special election for the 7th Congressional District. WSMV found no campaign site or contact information.

candidates.name: Lauren Pinkston
candidates.background: Business professor at Lipscomb University; has taught fourth grade and done anti-trafficking work with Freedom Business Alliance. Doctorate from Clemson University; lives in Columbia (WSMV).

candidates.name: Victor L. Scoggin
candidates.background: U.S. Navy veteran, retired volunteer firefighter and retired Ford/UAW journeyman. Born in Nashville; lives in Pegram (WSMV).

candidates.name: Dave Seeman
candidates.background: Mechanical engineer (UT Knoxville); co-owns Fractal Hardware, a Nashville product development agency, and worked in material handling at the Uranium Processing Facility in Oak Ridge. Born in Nashville (WSMV).

candidates.name: Karl Knox Smithson
candidates.background: Community activist for homeless people, from McMinnville. WSMV found no campaign site or contact information.

candidates.name: L. Webb Taylor
candidates.background: Independent candidate from Memphis, per the Secretary of State's certified list.

candidates.name: Robert C. Vick
candidates.background: Public school teacher, principal and athletic director in East Tennessee; doctorate in school leadership from East Tennessee State University. Born in White Pine (WSMV).

office_explainer: One of Tennessee's two U.S. senators. The Senate votes on federal laws and confirms federal judges and cabinet members. A term is six years.
why_it_matters: Sen. Bill Hagerty, first elected in 2020, is running for a second term. Two party nominees and eight independents are on the ballot.

candidates.name: Bill Hagerty
candidates.background: U.S. senator, first elected in 2020. Born in Gallatin; lives in Nashville. Degrees from Vanderbilt University and Vanderbilt Law School (WSMV). The link is his Senate office site.

candidates.name: Marquita Bradshaw
candidates.background: Executive director of Sowing Justice, an environmental nonprofit. Born and raised in Memphis; degree from the University of Memphis (WSMV).

candidates.name: Tharon Chandler
